purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Coinbase Clearing DCO Registration — 2026
question: Did the CFTC approve Coinbase to clear derivatives, what exactly did the order authorize, and does it establish live in-house clearing, USDC-native settlement or approval of Coinbase's proposed single-stock perpetual futures?
bluf: On September 28, 2026 the Commission registered Coinbase Clearing LLC as a derivatives clearing organization for fully collateralized futures, options on futures and swaps. The order creates a real affiliated clearing permission, with FCM and self-clearing membership routes, but does not approve a named product, USDC or blockchain settlement, spot or securities clearing, migration from Nodal Clear, or an operating launch. Current state: DCO registration effective; fully collateralized clearing permission live; first-product and first-clearing operating receipt not yet located.
evidence_cutoff_note: The Commission order, DCO filing page, application rulebook, proposed-activities summary, ownership exhibit, current CFTC venue listing, Coinbase clearing disclosures and SEC security-futures filings were checked. No first member, first product, first trade, eligible-collateral notice, settlement-institution designation or migration from Nodal Clear was located.
use_note: Carry the Commission registration as live legal authority but keep product admission, member onboarding, collateral designation, settlement configuration and first clearing as separate clocks. Do not infer approval of USDC, Base, spot crypto, securities, existing margined perpetuals or proposed single-stock perpetual futures.
entities: The Clearing Company of San Francisco, LLC
